title: Studio: /studio/~all/metadata/<type> cannot be opened; ResourceListPage's ?package= repair rewrites the cross-package list to one package's leg
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① a measured regression of a landed route, found by the #28579 slice 3 run (run record #29560, PR #29559 `FOLLOW-UPS.md` §15b item 3). The seat read the repair in source; it has not re-measured the redirect.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx`, the effect after the "Repair `?package=`" comment, about line 344).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `ResourceListPage package`, `~all metadata`. No card.
reach: every Setup metadata URL that redirects to Studio's cross-package area, and every bookmark of it.
type: Bug

## What happens
Typed directly, even with `?package=all`, `/_console/studio/~all/metadata/object` and `/_console/studio/~all/metadata/flow` are rewritten to `?package=com.example.showcase`, and then to that package's leg. The list of a type across all packages cannot be opened. The repair runs whenever the area names no package.

This fails `platform-core.setup-metadata-redirects-to-studio` acceptance[0] (for `/apps/setup/metadata/object`) and acceptance[3] (the package-less Packaged automation bookmark).

## Wanted
The `~all` area keeps its cross-package list. The repair picks a package only where the page actually needs one (create, or a leg that is per-package), and never on the `~all` list. Pin the `~all` URL staying put.
